# sharepoint_list (Resource)

Creates a SharePoint list or library using the M365 CLI (m365 spo list add / get / set / remove). Covers the properties shared by `list add` and `list set`; use sharepoint_list_view for views, sharepoint_field for columns. The `direction` property is known to come back from SharePoint lowercased regardless of the uppercase value sent, which may show as a perpetual diff.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sharepoint_list" "requests" {
  web_url       = "https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/hr"
  title         = "Requests"
  description   = "Incoming HR requests."
  base_template = "GenericList"

  enable_versioning   = true
  major_version_limit = 50
  on_quick_launch     = true
}

resource "sharepoint_list" "policies" {
  web_url       = "https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/hr"
  title         = "Policies"
  base_template = "DocumentLibrary"

  enable_versioning     = true
  enable_minor_versions = true
  force_checkout        = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Title of the list. Changing this renames the list in place.
- `web_url` (String) URL of the site where the list should be created.

### Optional

- `allow_deletion` (Boolean) Whether the list can be deleted.
- `allow_everyone_view_items` (Boolean) Whether everyone can view documents/attachments in the list.
- `allow_multi_responses` (Boolean) Whether users can give multiple responses to a survey.
- `base_template` (String) List definition type the list is based on. Immutable after creation.
- `content_types_enabled` (Boolean) Whether content types are enabled for the list.
- `crawl_non_default_views` (Boolean) Whether to crawl non-default views.
- `default_content_approval_workflow_id` (String) GUID of the default content approval workflow.
- `default_display_form_url` (String) Location of the default display form.
- `default_edit_form_url` (String) URL of the edit form used for list items.
- `description` (String) Description of the list.
- `direction` (String) Reading order of the list.
- `disable_commenting` (Boolean) Whether commenting is disabled on the list.
- `disable_grid_editing` (Boolean) Whether grid editing is disabled on the list.
- `draft_version_visibility` (String) Minimum permission required to view minor versions and drafts.
- `email_alias` (String) Email address notified when an assignment changes or an item updates.
- `enable_assign_to_email` (Boolean) Whether e-mail notification is enabled for the list.
- `enable_attachments` (Boolean) Whether attachments can be added to items.
- `enable_deploy_with_dependent_list` (Boolean) Whether the list can be deployed with a dependent list.
- `enable_folder_creation` (Boolean) Whether folders can be created in the list.
- `enable_minor_versions` (Boolean) Whether minor versions are enabled (document libraries).
- `enable_moderation` (Boolean) Whether content approval is enabled.
- `enable_people_selector` (Boolean) Enables the user selector on an event list.
- `enable_resource_selector` (Boolean) Enables the resource selector on an event list.
- `enable_schema_caching` (Boolean) Whether schema caching is enabled.
- `enable_syndication` (Boolean) Whether RSS syndication is enabled.
- `enable_throttling` (Boolean) Whether list throttling is enabled.
- `enable_versioning` (Boolean) Whether versioning is enabled (document libraries).
- `enforce_data_validation` (Boolean) Whether certain field properties are enforced on add/update.
- `exclude_from_offline_client` (Boolean) Whether the list is excluded from offline sync.
- `fetch_property_bag_for_list_view` (Boolean) Whether property bag info is retrieved when rendering the list.
- `followable` (Boolean) Whether the list can be followed in an activity feed.
- `force_checkout` (Boolean) Whether forced checkout is enabled (document libraries).
- `force_default_content_type` (Boolean) Whether to return the default Document root content type.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Whether the list is hidden.
- `included_in_my_files_scope` (Boolean) Whether the list is accessible under an OAuth scope containing "myfiles".
- `irm_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Information Rights Management is enabled.
- `irm_expire` (Boolean) Whether IRM expiration is enabled.
- `irm_reject` (Boolean) Whether IRM rejection is enabled.
- `is_application_list` (Boolean) Whether the list is treated as a top-level navigation object.
- `list_experience_options` (String) List experience: Auto, NewExperience, or ClassicExperience.
- `major_version_limit` (Number) Maximum number of major versions kept (also enables versioning if set).
- `major_with_minor_versions_limit` (Number) Maximum number of major versions kept when both major and minor versioning are used.
- `multiple_data_list` (Boolean) Whether the list holds data for multiple meeting instances (Meeting Workspace).
- `navigate_for_forms_pages` (Boolean) Whether to navigate to forms pages instead of using a modal dialog.
- `need_update_site_client_tag` (Boolean) Whether editing documents increments the site's ClientTag.
- `no_crawl` (Boolean) Whether crawling is disabled for the list.
- `on_quick_launch` (Boolean) Whether the list appears on the Quick Launch.
- `ordered` (Boolean) Whether users can reorder items from the Edit View page.
- `parser_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the parser is disabled for the list.
- `read_only_ui` (Boolean) Whether the list's UI is presented read-only (does not affect security).
- `read_security` (Number) Read security: 1 (all users read all items) or 2 (users read only items they created).
- `request_access_enabled` (Boolean) Whether users can request access to the list.
- `restrict_user_updates` (Boolean) Whether the list is restricted (cannot toggle once it has items).
- `send_to_location_name` (String) Display name for the "send to" location.
- `send_to_location_url` (String) URL used when copying an item to another document library.
- `show_user` (Boolean) Whether user names are shown in survey results.
- `template_feature_id` (String) GUID of a template feature associated with the list.
- `use_forms_for_display` (Boolean) Whether forms are used for display context.
- `validation_formula` (String) Formula evaluated when a list item is added or updated.
- `validation_message` (String) Message shown when item validation fails.
- `version_auto_expire_trim` (Boolean) Whether automatic version trimming is enabled. Cannot be combined with version_expire_after_days unless this is false. Only settable after creation (list set).
- `version_expire_after_days` (Number) Days after which a version is removed; set major_version_limit alongside this. Only settable after creation (list set).
- `write_security` (Number) Write security: 1 (all users modify all items), 2 (users modify only items they created), or 4 (no user modifications).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GUID assigned to the list by SharePoint.
